text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
――In 1st place is Mejiro Ramonu!
Mejiro Ramonu takes the first crown of the Triple Tiara!!
She has won the "Oka Sho"--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohh...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Ramonu-sama...!
A magnificent and brilliant victory!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The second crown, the Yushun Himba (Oaks),
will surely belong to Lady Ramonu as well...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu... has accomplished it.
Shall you go over to speak with her?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me.
I'll leave a handkerchief... right here for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"...Ramonu did it.
She won the Classic."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Ramonu—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ramonuuu!!
Lady Ramonuuuuu~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
All at once...
In full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Just like the cherry blossoms.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"My heat spreads...
and one by one... they blossom."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
And so...
they burst into full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Devoted and vivid,
the colors of love...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Even if they scatter and fall, I won't forget them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Now... I wonder how heavy
the oak blossoms will hang.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: This should be quite a spectacle...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
...H-Huh... Ahaha, that's weird...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
I know how amazing Ms. Ramonu is... I really do.
But... to not even be able to step in her shadow...
Even though... I worked so hard, too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: ...Must be nice.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"Strength, beauty, pride...
She has... every single one of them..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
—Even someone like me.
Even I... surely—could have reached it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After successfully winning the Oka Sho
and finishing packing up to head home...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Lady Ramonu~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work~.
That was truly a wonderful race~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Um... congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... the way you ran, and the moment you won...
it was brilliant, and so very cool.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I... still haven't decided on
my own path yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to run proudly and majestically...
just like Ms. Ramonu!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...S-Sorry to bother you when you're tired.
Pardon me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.
choice_data_list: You really are someone to admire, huh
You really are someone to look up to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Seems to be the case.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Warmth is nice, of course... but I'm also looking
forward to a piercing, sharp pain."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure... the next race
will have that very thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks"...
We'll meet again soon.
choice_data_list: Once again, congratulations on your first win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hello.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, full of spirit and drive...
we head into the second leg of the Tiara route, the Oaks!
